A School Built on Craft and Correction

Makeup is a physical skill. Brush pressure, blending timing, and skin reading only improve with a trained instructor standing beside you. That is why every program here runs face to face.

Our Mission

Teach makeup as a craft with discipline, structure, and professional standards. Every program runs face to face in the Quezon City studio: real models, immediate correction, no online modules and no recorded demos.

Our Vision

Graduates leave with more than a certificate: working technique, a portfolio, OJT hours on real productions, and an alumni network that stays useful long after the final class.

Instruction at the Quezon City studio.

A Pioneering Figure in Philippine Makeup Artistry.

Faye Young has worked across bridal couture, fashion editorial, film and television, theatre, and international pageant stages for over 27 years.

She has been faculty at the Australian College of Hair Design and Beauty Manila since 2015, training the next generation of makeup artists. Her technical background includes prosthetics and airbrush makeup, studied at Singapore's Top to Toe Makeup College, with further training under Filipino makeup educator Cecille Rebollos.

Credentials & recognition

  • President, Philippine Makeup Artist Association (PMUAA), 10+ years
  • Faculty, Australian College of Hair Design and Beauty Manila, since 2015
  • Official makeup team, Newport Performing Arts Theater: Bongga Ka, Day! The Annie Batungbakal Musical
  • Notable Academy for Make Up Artistry, 7th Global Trends
  • Official judge, IROG Year 7 Bridal Hair and Makeup Competition
  • Prosthetics and airbrush studies, Top to Toe Makeup College, Singapore
  • Advanced training under makeup educator Cecille Rebollos

Every Instructor Is a Working Professional.

Instructors specialize across bridal, SFX, airbrush, hairstyling, and editorial makeup. Each brings current client and production experience into the room, and correction is given at the chair, on your hand, on the model in front of you.

Ask who is teaching your dates when you inquire. We will tell you plainly, and if that artist's specialty is not the one you need, we will point you to the class that is.
